profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at TraceLink
profile.summary:
Software engineer with experience working at scale, primarily in the back-end in a microservices-based environment, although I work across the stack. I have experience in developing and supporting both customer-critical end user apps operating at scale as well as internal platform apps used by hundreds of other developers to get their work done. I believe in understandable software, clear and prompt communication, data integrity, and not taking myself too seriously!

Graduated from Cornell University with a degree in Information Science, Systems and Technology in June 2019.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Interned on Network Applications team, which provides microservices for internal and external use.
- Extended existing developer tools for creating and maintaining microservices. 
- Improved security and functionality of microservices under development for future customer usage.
- Implemented thorough unit and Karate (HTTP) tests

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Built a proof-of-concept website using the Vue framework and related technologies (Ajax, vuetify, vue-router) that enabled loading, sorting, filtering, and searching of mock data based on a TraceLink pharmacy iOS app. Website was demonstrated internally to show the possible viability of Vue UI technologies for future projects.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Built a 'developer wizard' IntelliJ plugin used to familiarize new TraceLink developers with contextually relevant tips and information. Installing this plugin became part of the standard on-boarding process for developers working on our legacy systems.
